tools.name: directiq_get_contact
tools.description: Get a single contact by its numeric ID.

tools.name: directiq_contact_count
tools.description: Get the total number of contacts in the account.

tools.name: directiq_update_contact
tools.description: Update a contact by ID. Provide the fields to change (e.g. firstName, lastName, email).

tools.name: directiq_get_list
tools.description: Get a contact list by its numeric ID.

tools.name: directiq_get_tag
tools.description: Get a tag by its numeric ID.

tools.name: directiq_account_overview
tools.description: Summarize the account: total contacts, active/disabled status counts, list count, tag count, and confirmed sender addresses. Individual sections degrade gracefully if unavailable.

tools.name: directiq_list_endpoints
tools.description: List known DirectIQ API operations (HTTP method, API group, path, summary). Optionally filter by a search term. Call GET operations with directiq_read_request and POST/PUT/PATCH/DELETE operations with directiq_write_request.

tools.name: directiq_read_request

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: directiq_list_endpoints, directiq_read_request · Private data: directiq_get_contact, directiq_list_contacts, directiq_contact_count, directiq_update_contact, directiq_list_lists, directiq_get_list, directiq_create_list, directiq_account_overview, directiq_read_request, directiq_write_request · Public sink: directiq_update_contact, directiq_send_email, directiq_list_endpoints, directiq_write_request · Destructive: directiq_list_endpoints, directiq_write_request.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: directiq_list_endpoints, directiq_read_request · Private data: directiq_get_contact, directiq_list_contacts, directiq_contact_count, directiq_update_contact, directiq_list_lists, directiq_get_list, directiq_create_list, directiq_account_overview, directiq_read_request, directiq_write_request · Public sink: directiq_update_contact, directiq_send_email, directiq_list_endpoints, directiq_write_request · Destructive: directiq_list_endpoints, directiq_write_request

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
